import fs from 'node:fs';import path from 'node:path';
import { readProposalArchive, readProposalDetailFacts } from '/Users/hudsonheadley/conductor/workspaces/poa-cli/halifax-v1/packages/core/src/reads/vote.ts';
const base='/Users/hudsonheadley/conductor/workspaces/poa-frontend/albuquerque-v4';const config=fs.readFileSync(path.join(base,'poa-app/src/config/networks.js'),'utf8');const urls=[...config.matchAll(/subgraphUrl:.*?\|\| '([^']+)'/g)].map(m=>m[1]);
const orgId='0x263b2b29f392647f0fb8ddbb26f099e812ab4ba2777e5e07b906277164181f6b';
const q=async(document:string,variables:any)=>{const r=await fetch(urls[1],{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',Origin:'https://poa.box'},body:JSON.stringify({query:document,variables}),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000)});const j=await r.json();if(j.errors)throw new Error('GraphQL error');return j.data;};
async function main(){const discovery=await q('query($id:ID!){organization(id:$id){id hybridVoting{id}} _meta{block{number hash timestamp}}}',{id:orgId});const hv=discovery.organization.hybridVoting.id,block=discovery._meta.block,out=[];
for(const [which,contract] of [['valid-module-unseen-proposal',hv],['unrelated-empty-module','0x0000000000000000000000000000000000123456']]){const source:any={chainId:100,orgId,contract,endpoint:'serving-gnosis-redacted',method:'root-empty-binding-review',indexed:true,snapshot:'pinned',block:{number:String(block.number),hash:block.hash}};const details=await readProposalDetailFacts({source,query:q,lane:'hybrid',compositeId:contract+'-115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935'});const feed=which==='unrelated-empty-module'?await readProposalArchive({source,query:q,lane:'hybrid',pageSize:1,maxPages:1}):null;out.push({which,contract,detailCoverage:details.coverage,proposal:details.data.proposal,archiveCoverage:feed?.coverage,archiveRows:feed?.data.length});}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(base,'.context/tmp/core-update/root-governance-review/empty-bindings-terminal.json'),JSON.stringify({readOnly:true,sourceDiscovery:discovery,out},null,2));console.log(JSON.stringify(out.map(r=>({which:r.which,detailCoverage:r.detailCoverage.status,proposal:r.proposal.state,proposalValue:r.proposal.state==='known'?r.proposal.value:'unknown',archiveCoverage:r.archiveCoverage?.status,archiveRows:r.archiveRows}))));}
main().catch(()=>{console.error('Read-only governance probe did not complete');process.exitCode=1;});
